phase_name: Fallback-forced test + Alur SyGuS regression fixture

objectives.description: Two-column regression fixture with reading-order assertion
Optional real Alur PDF stronger check, skip-with-warning when absent
Document how to obtain the real Alur PDF

approaches_tried.approach: Two-column fixture using insert_text() for whole unwrapped sentences
approaches_tried.reason: Lines wide enough to span both columns' x-ranges, defeating column-band clustering for both engine tiers. Not representative of real multi-column PDFs. Fixed with insert_textbox() + column-width-constrained rectangles.
Heavy false positives on legitimate math tuple/list notation (x,Y) common throughout this math-heavy corpus. Restricted to period-only.

deviations.description: Additional quality-gate detector beyond Phase 5's four
deviations.reason: While building the Phase 6 test harness, discovered a real, previously-undetected word-fusion defect in pymupdf4llm's extraction of a real corpus document (Goldblatt/Hodkinson/Venema 2003) that none of Phase 5's four detectors catch. Added a fifth detector (sentence_boundary_glue_count) to literature-convert.sh's quality gate to close this gap, consistent with the task's zero-silent-corruption mandate.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — Phase 5's quality gate extended with a fifth detector discovered during Phase 6 test-harness construction)*
